verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items discuss TypeScript prop/event type inference, generics, or type-checking tooling (e.g. svelte-check, $props typing); one community comment even notes IDE/type support has historically been an issue, but this is not concrete enough to dispute a specific claim since no vendor claim about auto type inference appears in the pack.
